title: Untitled (Turquoise Ground Collage)
description: Layered collage on a saturated turquoise ground incorporates pasted paper panels in yellow, white, and magenta, covered with loose black ink drawings of figures, plant forms, and gestural marks. Numerals appear in the lower right corner alongside scattered marks across the entire picture plane.
composition: two collaged panels flanking turquoise ground
keywords: gestural ink drawing on painted ground
